“Ufo: Final Movement” Week 7 Pre-Release Event: Autographed Postcards Available Starting October 23!

Based on the novel by Ayano Takeda, Kyoto Animation’s “Sound! Euphonium” series—which has depicted the high school lives of students dedicated to their wind ensemble over the course of 10 years—has announced the giveaway for the seventh week of screenings of the second part of “Final Movement: Sound! Euphonium,” the series finale.

From October 23 to October 29, 2026, a limited number of “Congratulations on Your Graduation, Kumiko! Group Message Card”—a gift from the members of the Kita-Uji High School Wind Ensemble to their graduating club president, Kumiko Komae—will be distributed.

Key Points of This Article

・Week 7 Giveaway for “The Final Movement: Sound! Euphonium” Part 2
・“Congratulations on Your Graduation, Kumiko!” signed color paper presented to Club President Kumiko by the Kita-Uji High School Wind Ensemble
・Standard-sized color paper featuring recreations of handwritten messages from each club member
・Distribution period: October 23–29, 2026
・Limited quantity; available while supplies last

The article continues after the following advertisement

“Final Movement: Sound! Euphonium” Part 2: Overview of Week 7 Attendee Gifts

The Week 7 attendee gifts for “Final Movement: Sound! Euphonium” Part 2, currently in theaters since September 11, 2026, have been announced. It is a reproduction of the autographed color paper presented to Club President Kumiko Komae by the Kita-Uji High School Wind Ensemble at her graduation ceremony, on which each club member has handwritten their feelings for President Kumiko.

* Please refrain from making comments that may disturb other theatergoers, such as requests to exchange, transfer, or sell the gift inside the theater

“Final Movement: Sound! Euphonium” Part 2: Contents of the Group Autograph Card

In the center of the autograph card are the words “To Club President Kumiko Kimae” along with messages congratulating her on her graduation, surrounded by messages from the club members. In the released samples, you can see messages from Hazuki, Reina, and Midori; their respective handwriting and illustrations convey the sense of camaraderie they’ve built over the past three years.

Attendee Gifts So Far for “Final Movement: Sound! Euphonium” Part 2

For Part 2, attendee gifts have been distributed on a weekly rotation since the film’s opening week. The “Special Thanks Book” from Week 4 is featured in the Week 4 article.

Gifts for Attendees of Part 2
Week 1 Gold Foil-Stamped Graduation Cards (Random selection from 6 types)
September 11–17, 2026
Week 2 Gold Foil-Stamped Graduation Card (Random from 6 designs)
September 18–24, 2026
Week 3 Audio Drama Download Card
September 25–October 1, 2026
Week 4 Special Thanks Book
October 2–8, 2026
Week 6 Exclusive “Connecting & Weaving” Visual Cards (2 designs total)
October 16–22, 2026
Week 7 Congratulations on Your Graduation, Kumiko! Group Message Card
October 23–29, 2026

The official website also announces the finale stage greeting and live viewing for the second part, as well as the “Screening with Ms. Michie’s Box of Tissues” event to be held on November 3 at Shinjuku Piccadilly and MOVIX Kyoto. For details, please check the official website.

Frequently Asked Questions About the Week 7 Giveaway for “Final Movement: Sound! Euphonium” Part 2

What is the Week 7 giveaway for Part 2?

“Congratulations on Graduation, Kumiko! Signed Color Paper.” This is a signed color paper presented by the members of the Kita-Uji High School Wind Ensemble to their graduating club president, Kumiko Komae, and there is only one type available.

When will it be distributed?

From October 23 to October 29, 2026. Supplies are limited, so distribution will end once they run out.

How many can each person receive?

One per screening. Since this is not a ticket purchase bonus, it will not be distributed to those who do not enter the theater.
